# nutanix_roles_v2 (Data Source)

Lists Nutanix IAM roles through the provisional IAM v4.0 API surface.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) OData filter expression.
- `limit` (Number) Maximum records returned, from 1 through 100.
- `order_by` (String) OData order-by expression.
- `page` (Number) Zero-based result page. Omitted values use the server default.
- `select` (String) Comma-separated simple properties to request in addition to required state fields.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Deterministic identity of the caller-supplied list query.
- `role_entities` (Attributes List) IAM roles returned by Nutanix. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--role_entities))
